idea-plugin.name: WildFly Community Runner
idea-plugin.description: Local WildFly integration for IntelliJ IDEA Community: application-wide WildFly process detection/management, Maven/Gradle multi-service workspaces, lexicographic hierarchical project discovery, external deployment tracking with remembered source paths, artifact-watched Auto Redeploy, deterministic scanner cleanup for redeploy/undeploy, browser launch with configurable context paths and HTTP port, debug start/attach, JVM-option shortcuts, and compact IntelliJ-style Services/Logs tooling.
